class.name: FoxAttributeMap
class.brief_description: A recursive, hierarchical Blackboard node for safely managing dynamic entity data, stacked flags, and rules.
class.description: Acts as a centralized data hub for an entity. It can store any arbitrary [Variant] data (such as [int], [String], or [FoxStatPool] resources), tracks temporary binary states via stacked string flags, and safely propagates [FoxAttributeRule]s up and down a node hierarchy.

method.name: set_data
method.description: Adds or updates a piece of data in the internal dictionary. Emits [signal data_added] if the [param key] is new, or [signal data_replaced] if the [param key] already exists.

method.name: get_data
method.description: Retrieves data associated with the given [param key]. Returns [param default_value] if the [param key] does not exist.

method.name: has_data
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the exact key exists in the data dictionary.

method.name: erase_data
method.description: Completely removes data associated with the given [param key] and purges it from any associated groups. Emits [signal data_removed].

method.name: add_data_to_group
method.description: Associates an existing data [param key] with a specific [param group] string for bulk querying.

method.name: erase_data_from_group
method.description: Removes a specific data key from a group.

method.name: erase_data_from_all_groups
method.description: Helper function that purges a key from all groups it currently belongs to.

method.name: get_data_in_group
method.description: Returns an array of all actual data [Variant]s currently associated with the target [param group].

method.name: create_group
method.description: Explicitly creates an empty group tracking array.

method.name: erase_group
method.description: Completely destroys a [param group] and disassociates all keys inside of it. Returns [code]true[/code] if the [param group] existed and was erased, or [code]false[/code] if it did not exist.

method.name: has_group
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the group exists.

method.name: increment_flag
method.description: Adds one stack to a string-based [param flag]. If this is the first stack applied, emits [signal flag_added]. Always emits [signal flag_changed].

method.name: decrement_flag
method.description: Removes one stack from a string-based [param flag]. If the stack count reaches [code]0[/code], the flag is erased entirely and emits [signal flag_removed].

method.name: has_flag
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the [param flag] exists with at least one stack.

method.name: get_flag_stacks
method.description: Returns the exact number of times this flag has been stacked.

method.name: erase_flag
method.description: Forcefully removes all stacks of a flag instantly.

method.name: clear_all_flags
method.description: Forcefully purges all active flags on the entity.

method.name: add_rule
method.description: Applies a data-modifying [FoxAttributeRule] to the internal data and propagates it to children if [member can_send_rules] is [code]true[/code].

method.name: remove_rule
method.description: Removes a [FoxAttributeRule] by matching its [member FoxAttributeRule.rule_id]. Reverses the rule's mathematical effects on the local data and emits [signal rule_removed].

method.name: get_active_rules
method.description: Returns the array of currently active and applied [FoxAttributeRule]s.

method.name: register_child_map
method.description: Links a child map to this parent, passing down all current rules and flags.

method.name: unregister_child_map
method.description: Unlinks a child map and strips away any rules and flags it inherited from this parent.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], this map will accept and apply rules propagated from a parent map.
If [code]true[/code], this map will propagate its active rules down to any registered child maps.

signal.name: data_added
signal.description: Emitted when a new [param key] is added to the data with the given [param value].

signal.name: data_replaced
signal.description: Emitted when the [param value] of an existing [param key] is overwritten.

signal.name: data_removed
signal.description: Emitted when a data [param key] is completely removed from the map.

signal.name: data_added_to_group
signal.description: Emitted when a data [param key] is categorized into a [param group].

signal.name: data_removed_from_group
signal.description: Emitted when a data [param key] is removed from a [param group].

signal.name: rule_added
signal.description: Emitted when an active [param rule] is applied to this map.

signal.name: rule_removed
signal.description: Emitted when an active [param rule] expires or is removed.

signal.name: flag_added
signal.description: Emitted the first time a [param flag]'s stack reaches [code]1[/code].

signal.name: flag_removed
signal.description: Emitted when a [param flag]'s stack reaches [code]0[/code] and is completely removed.

signal.name: flag_changed
signal.description: Emitted any time a [param flag]'s stack count increases or decreases.
